name: Imogen Todd
title: Psychosexual & Relationship Therapist (Mental Health Accredited Social Worker)
description: A queer-identifying psychosexual and relationship therapist. I offer neurodiverse, LGBTQIA+ and sex work affirming therapy... related to mental health, relationships, sexual wellbeing and identity. I work with ENM relationships and draw on ACT, EMDR, Schema, EFT and IFS. I am a trauma-informed therapist.
specialties: sex therapy, psychosexual therapy, LGBTQIA+, sex work affirming, ENM, EMDR, schema therapy, IFS, trauma-informed

name: Alex Sutherland
title: Counsellor & Sex Therapist
practice: Inclusive Therapy – Sex and Relationship Counselling
description: Counselling and Sex Therapy based in Brunswick... Alex (she/her) is a queer and neurodivergent qualified Counsellor. We welcome sex workers, LGBTIQA+ SB folk and marginalised communities. We are trauma-informed, gender-affirming, neuro-affirming, poly and kink-friendly.
specialties: sex therapy, relationships, LGBTIQA+, gender-affirming, kink-friendly, poly-friendly, trauma-informed, sex workers

name: Emma Vasey
title: Psychotherapist, Couples Counsellor & Sexologist
description: A therapeutic clinic that focuses on emotional processing, attachment theory, and trauma processing. Clients address pressure and fear in relationships and sex, childhood neglect and abuse (including sexual), sexual distress and sexual dysfunction; many clients are ethically non-monogamous, neurodiverse and LGBTQIA+. Modalities include EFT, Internal Family Systems (IFS) / Parts Work and Somatic Psychotherapy.
specialties: sex therapy, sexology, couples, trauma, IFS/parts work, LGBTQIA+, ENM

name: Kevin Vun
title: Counsellor, Psychotherapist & Relationship Therapist
description: I work with queer people... Gay, bi, trans, non-binary, questioning & gender-diverse clients; people in monogamous, ENM, open, kink-aware, or non-traditional relationships; clients working through trauma, attachment wounds, shame, addiction. Approach draws on EMDR (trauma processing), Gottman Method, EFT and somatic approaches. I'm a queer, Asian male psychotherapist.
specialties: queer, trans and gender-diverse, EMDR, trauma, kink-aware, ENM, couples, Gottman

name: Lette (Let) Jewell
title: Somatic Psychotherapist
description: I'm Lette (they/them) – a two-spirited, queer, neurodivergent psychotherapist offering culturally grounded, trauma-informed support for LGBTIQA+ communities... identity and gender journeys; complex, intergenerational, and collective trauma. I create safer spaces for all identities—especially for queer, trans, BIPOC, neurodivergent, and disabled folks.
specialties: somatic psychotherapy, complex trauma, LGBTIQA+, gender, neurodivergence, culturally grounded

name: Jodie
title: AOD & Mental Health Counsellor
description: I identify as non-binary, pansexual and am proudly LGBTIAQ+ affirming, and am fiercely sex-work positive & kink aware. Compassionate & trauma-sensitive approach; supports chemsex / PnP experiences or 'sex addiction'. Uses somatic stabilisation and EMDR (EMDR Institute trained).
specialties: LGBTIAQ+, trauma, EMDR, kink aware, sex work positive, chemsex, AOD, somatic

name: Matthew Austin
title: Accredited Mental Health Social Worker / Counsellor
description: Caring & non-judgemental counselling for LGBTQIA+ adults... we can begin to understand how feelings of shame have been shaped by trauma in relationships. Trained in Gestalt psychotherapy and EMDR levels 1 & 2.

name: Dudley Benson
title: Psychodynamic Psychotherapist
description: Psychodynamic psychotherapist (Conversational Model) working with childhood trauma, conflicts with sexuality, gender dysphoria, diagnosed disorders such as BPD & Dissociation. Enjoy working with people in the LGBTQIA+ community; 42 year old queer cis male New Zealander.
specialties: psychodynamic, Conversational Model, dissociation, BPD, childhood trauma, gender dysphoria, sexuality, LGBTQIA+
